verdict.rationale: Pika publishes a vendor-owned developer platform with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec (server api.dev.pika.art) and per-operation /v1/media/{vendor}/{model}/{function} generation endpoints, so submitting a video generation request through a documented API is clearly evidenced. The evidence does not describe how a finished asset is retrieved, and the API is an aggregator of hosted third-party models rather than Pika-only. Missing for 10: documented job-status/polling or webhook flow, explicit asset retrieval/download endpoint, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end submit-and-retrieve run.

support.subject: As a developer, I can submit a video generation job through a documented API and retrieve the finished asset
